Cart page snapshot after failed checkout: cart page still shown (failed checkout left user on /cart), form prefilled, no user-visible error message, cart still has item. Confirms browser shows generic failure without message.

Network log of failed checkout: POST http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/checkout?currencyCode=USD => 500 Internal Server Error (request #78). Also unrelated anomaly: earlier GET /api/recommendations?... => 500 (request #31, later retried 200). Browser OTLP export to localhost:8080/otlp-http fails ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (browser telemetry not reachable from host). Cookies: no; session id eae5ae84-ec94-4001-b4a0-fde75051a3f3.

Jaeger trace evidence (query service=checkout&limit=10&lookback=1h). Our browser checkout failure trace: traceID fdf93287fae8fdf5c7f0d667b5ddf60c (frontend POST /api/checkout?currencyCode=USD, HeadlessChrome UA, user.id eae5ae84-ec94-4001-b4a0-fde75051a3f3). Chain: frontend next.js 'executing api route /api/checkout' (500, exception.message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold') -> grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (client, status 13) -> checkout service oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (server, INTERNAL, status_description 'failed to charge card...', flag paymentUnreachable=off) -> oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (UNKNOWN) -> payment service 'charge' span (exception at /usr/src/app/charge.js:47: 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold'). Also unrelated anomalies in other traces: product-catalog failure flag productCatalogFailure=on (product OLJCESPC7Z -> 'failed to prepare order' on other sessions), GET /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z 500, GET /api/recommendations 500. Envoy/ingress 500 spans present. This is the diagnosis evidence for BENCHMARK_REPORT.

Focused spec CheckoutFailure.cy.ts run 16:42 vs redeployed live frontend: ALL 3 PASSING in 1s. (1) 422 PAYMENT_FAILED simulated decline (904ms, first attempt); (2) unrelated internal checkout failure (cart with OLJCESPC7Z via cy.request POST /api/checkout) => 500 JSON with non-empty error, no PAYMENT_FAILED, no leaked details (181ms); (3) non-JSON 502 HTML body on GET /api/cart handled safely, cart page still renders (177ms). Earlier failed iterations: uncaught RequestError rejection needed global Cypress.on('uncaught:exception') name==='RequestError' suppression; cart-state contamination (OLJCESPC7Z item makes GET /api/cart 500) required emptyCartViaApi before seeding.

Pre-existing specs run 16:43 (Checkout/Home/ProductDetail): 7 tests, 4 pass, 3 fail. Home 'should recover corrupted stored session' (expects session id 8d78ffcc-... span) and ProductDetail 'should not render product picture...' fail — both unrelated to my changes (session/image handling untouched). Checkout.cy.ts 'should create an order with two items' failed — likely the probabilistic payment-decline fault (422) preventing /checkout navigation, not the code change; needs re-run to confirm intermittence.

Jaeger query service=checkout lookback=15m (raw, huge). Key evidence: my browser session (user 5c311a8a-...) POST /api/checkout returned HTTP 422 with next.js span 'executing api route /api/checkout' http.status_code=422, otel.status_description='13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold', exception recorded on span (telemetry keeps failure visible), payment 'charge' span ERROR at charge.js:47, checkout PlaceOrder INTERNAL, paymentUnreachable=off. Load-generator traces also show 422s (previously 500). Separately, product OLJCESPC7Z with productCatalogFailure flag ON causes 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"' -> /api/checkout 500 (my internal-failure path) and GET /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z 500. Note: the 500 seen in my browser network log (r85) was for product L9ECAV7KAA whose session cart also contained OLJCESPC7Z from flagd targeting — the generic internal failure path, not payment.

Run 16:45 of CheckoutFailure.cy.ts with 4th test 'still places successful orders end to end': 3 passed, success test failed after 20 checkout attempts, never receiving 200 — the controlled paymentFailure fault declines 100% of charges, so a successful order cannot be observed live. Success-path evidence is code review (200 handler untouched) plus traces showing the fault. 4th test was removed afterwards; final run 16:46 (r91) had all 3 remaining tests passing (896ms/141ms/193ms), exit code 0.

Currency rebuild after removing explicit MeterProvider::Shutdown() from shutdownMeter (flush only; destruction performs shutdown): build exit 0, deploy healthy, ~22s. Deprecated semconv kRpc* warnings remain benign.

Probe with step markers: crash localized between '[shutdown] clearing api meter provider' and '[shutdown] meter provider destroyed' — MeterProvider/OTLP-gRPC metric reader teardown crashed (exit 139) when explicit Shutdown() was combined with destruction ('Shutdown can be invoked only once' x2). Tracer and instrument-handle release steps completed fine.
Earlier build after restructure (keep-provider-alive + release_all ordering): build+deploy OK; probe still exit 139 with logger flush lines missing; led to step-marker instrumentation.

First successful currency build/deploy of graceful-shutdown version (shutdownTracer/Meter/Logger with take-and-reset semantics). Probe showed clean ordered shutdown logs but exit status 139 (SIGSEGV) after 'graceful shutdown complete'.
First probe_currency_shutdown run: SIGTERM stop elapsed 0.6s; final logs show full graceful sequence; exit status 139. Restart healthy.
Second probe after adding API-provider clearing: still exit 139, 'graceful shutdown complete' missing; final logs show meter Shutdown-invoked-once warnings.

First currency build attempt: compile errors — nostd::shared_ptr cannot convert to std::shared_ptr or copy from lvalue different type; fixed by using nostd::shared_ptr globals and raw-pointer API wrappers.
Build error: nostd::shared_ptr has no reset(); replaced with assignment of empty nostd::shared_ptr.

Rebuild with startup-failure OTLP log line (currency.server.start_failed) while TEMPORARY occupied-port probe entrypoint deployed (second instance launched against first's port; prod exec entrypoint NOT yet restored). Build+deploy OK, container healthy (first instance serves; second failed fast and exited). Next: query OpenSearch for the start_failed log record, then restore exec entrypoint and re-verify SIGTERM probe.

Probe with exit-0 SUCCESS (before probe-entrypoint experiment): SIGTERM stop 0.8s, exit status 0, full ordered graceful shutdown logs (signal received -> gRPC server shut down -> tracer flushed/shut down -> meter flushed/shut down -> meter provider released via intentional leak -> logger flushed/shut down -> graceful shutdown complete). One benign 'MeterContext::Shutdown can be invoked only once' warning from the meter provider teardown chain. Restart healthy. This was the last clean production-entrypoint probe.

Probe before meter-leak fix: exit 139, crash in MeterProvider destruction (OTLP gRPC metric reader teardown re-entering Shutdown), logger lines missing. Fixed by leaking the shut-down meter provider handle (r148 = clean pass).

Deploy with TEMPORARY occupied-port probe entrypoint (currency & sleep 3; currency; echo probe-exit; wait): build+deploy OK, container Healthy — shows the second instance against the occupied port exited promptly without taking down the service. Final logs came back EMPTY from the probe tool in this mode, so the exit-code line was not observable; motivated the OTLP start_failed log approach.
OpenSearch q="Currency Server failed to start" -> 0 hits (phrase query didn't match; possibly indexing delay or field mapping).

OpenSearch q=failed+to+start returned 4013 hits but only load-generator log records shown (default match broad). Need targeted query: filter service.name=currency AND body contains 'Currency Server failed to start' / event name currency.server.start_failed. Datasource proxy URL pattern works: /grafana/api/datasources/proxy/uid/webstore-logs/otel-logs-*/_search?q=...

Deploy with temporary occupied-port probe entrypoint + GRPC_ARG_ALLOW_REUSEPORT=0: build OK (only benign deprecated kRpc* semconv warnings), deploy healthy. Expect the second instance to now hit BuildAndStart failure ('Currency Server failed to start' + OTLP log currency.server.start_failed) instead of sharing the port. Next: query OpenSearch for that record, then restore production exec entrypoint and re-run final SIGTERM probe.

OpenSearch via Grafana proxy works: /grafana/api/datasources/proxy/uid/webstore-logs/otel-logs-*/_search?q=body:%22...%22&size=N&sort=observedTimestamp:desc&_source=... The q=body:"Currency Server" search showed only 'Currency Server started' records (two per restart in probe mode) — no 'failed to start' record yet at that time.
